title: LOGOS ASF — TR-06E Evaluation Dossier
description: Sealed aggregated evaluation dossier for one registered Abigail candidate. Collects TR-06A metadata evaluation reports, TR-06C live evaluation plans, and TR-06D deterministic stub execution reports into one checksum-addressed evidence package. Classifies readiness_state without emitting a promotion decision. No real inference, provider calls, model weights, training, deployment, or promotion occurs here.

evaluation_dossier_id.description: Deterministic ID. Format: ED-<sha256[:16]>. Stable for same candidate + sorted input refs + readiness_state.

candidate_lineage_record_id.description: Lineage record ID from TR-05 model registry (may be empty string if not known).

source_model_registry_ref.description: Model registry path or identifier from which this candidate was drawn.

metadata_evaluation_report_refs.description: ER-* IDs of TR-06A metadata evaluation reports included in this dossier.

live_evaluation_plan_refs.description: LP-* IDs of TR-06C live evaluation plans included in this dossier.

stub_execution_report_refs.description: XR-* IDs of TR-06D stub execution reports included in this dossier.

gate_summary.description: Aggregated TR-06A gate result counts across all metadata evaluation reports.

stub_execution_summary.description: Aggregated TR-06D stub execution result counts across all stub execution reports.

readiness_state.description: Deterministic readiness classification. Does not constitute promotion eligibility. metadata_ready means no blocking evidence found and required metadata passed; it does not mean the candidate is ready for production.

readiness_rationale.description: Human-readable explanation of why readiness_state was assigned.

promotion_blocked.description: Always true. The dossier cannot promote a candidate.

promotion_decision_emitted.description: Always false. TR-06E never emits a promotion decision.

operator_review_required.description: Always true. Dossier contents require operator review before any further action.

real_model_inference_performed.description: Always false. TR-06E aggregates evidence only; no real inference occurred.

provider_calls_performed.description: Always false. No provider calls occurred in TR-06E.

model_weights_loaded.description: Always false. No model weights were loaded in TR-06E.

model_training_performed.description: Always false. No training occurred in TR-06E.

runtime_deployment_performed.description: Always false. No runtime deployment occurred in TR-06E.

store1_writes_performed.description: Always false. No Store 1 writes occurred in TR-06E.

blocked_actions.description: Actions blocked from occurring within this dossier.

dossier_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical dossier content (excluding dossier_hash itself). Provides tamper-evidence.

previous_dossier_hash.description: Hash of the previous dossier for this candidate, if any. Null for first dossier.

x-invariants.promotion_blocked_const: promotion_blocked is const:true. Dossier cannot promote a candidate.
x-invariants.promotion_decision_never: promotion_decision_emitted is const:false. No promotion pathway is opened.
x-invariants.metadata_ready_is_not_promotion: readiness_state='metadata_ready' does not constitute promotion eligibility. It means no blocking evidence was found.
x-invariants.no_tr07: TR-07 shadow/canary was not started here.
x-invariants.single_candidate: All input reports must share the same candidate_artifact_id.
x-invariants.dossier_hash_covers_content: dossier_hash is SHA-256 of canonical content excluding itself.
